about: Package 3a's accepted differences between the concept's page and the rebuild's in its states (slice-states/30-instruments.mjs), each with its reason and its exact count (vb.mjs compare --accept). A difference these do not cover fails the comparison; so does a count that changes.

accepted.why: Deviation 11 (slice-accepted.json): every button and input carries its type.

Eight takes on ACE-Step, the server's batch.max, where the concept offers nine (docs/03, Takes; deviation 30): a reel fewer, and the eight in two rows of four (the concept's rule for the grid, 25-module-takes.js).

In Tempo's top row the big number's pieces stand inside package 1's .lcd-numw (display: contents, so they stand in the row as the concept's do: containers-accepted.json counts the same); TAP stands with AUTO in its buttons, as the concept's.
Deviation 15 (package 1): an LCD's lit word names its parameter to a screen reader ("Beat intro and outro (DJ bars)" for BEAT I/O).
The LCD picker's arrows (.cyc) in standards mode (styles/rebuild/10-standards.css, the slice's): line-height 0 keeps them where the concept's quirks-mode page draws them.
Deviation 10: the wheel's Auto names its value ("", the option Auto stores), the concept's its word.
Deviation 10: the concept's paint hook on COMPOSE CAPTION USES THIS; the rebuild's note is the definition's, shown by its condition.
The concept keeps the cells it showed on the button (data-shown, data-prev) to roll from; the rebuild's split-flap keeps them in the part.
Package 1's lock hides its padlock drawing from a screen reader; its name is the button's.
Deviations 6 and 10: a segmented choice is a named group, and its buttons' hooks name their values.
Deviation 10: the read-out's link runs its node's action (a tier to go to and what to ring there), not the concept's [data-showmod] hook.
